title: str_replace on CRLF files needs CRLF anchors
body: cli.py is CRLF: an LF-only oldString silently matches nothing and the tool reports failure, not a partial edit. Read the file first (read_files shows CR markers), then encode anchors with CRLF. Lesson: check line endings before editing any file outside the UTF-8-LF norm, never retry the same anchor twice.

title: Staged scanner held the commit twice, fixed structurally both times
body: Commit A tripped the staged gate twice before landing: intuition.py except_return_default, then live_log.py silent_except_pass. Both fixed with a second recording statement via the tree note_failure idiom, never suppressed. Proof the gate works as designed: HEAD still read 0d47ae59 after the blocked attempt, and the passing gate plus 9 green tests preceded commit 244dd0ae. Lesson: write the recording statement in the first draft, not after the gate names it.
